why: Tail-call thunk for the hook pair at 0x00261588/0x0026158C. Its address is taken as a data immediate at 0x0013E42A and called indirectly, so no static call reaches it and the detector left 0x0013D835-0x0013D85F undetected between the functions ending 0x0013D834 and starting 0x0013D860. RECOMP_ICALL reported 'Failed to resolve VA 0x0013D840' three times per run, each during the D:\Media\Z_ADX\BGM\title.adx open, which is the last file activity of the boot.
